text:
alex_w: FYI acme-corp is seeing a lot of 502/504s from hosted inference since ~09:10 UTC. Customer reports SDK retries and unexpectedly large billing spikes. Putting initial logs below.

support_bot: Alert: 5xx-rate > 3% for tenant acme-corp (key: acct_acme_01) across us-west-2 in the last 20m :rotating_light:

alex_w: Repro notes from their SDK: high concurrency (200 concurrent requests, many batched embeds + generate). They said they didn't change code, traffic just spiked.

sadia_p: Can you paste a minimal repro curl + headers they used? Also need sample server-side logs (request_id, backend node) if available.

alex_w: customer shared this snippet they used in their load test:
```
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -sS -X POST 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer acct_acme_01" 
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
    -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"short prompt","max_tokens":128}' 
    https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate &
done
wait
```
They also included these backend snippets from our edge logs:
`edge_node=usw2-edge-34 request_id=req_abc123 backend=runtime-gpu-7 status=502 kvcache_wait_ms=2300 conn_reuse=true`

mike_g: Hmm kvcache_wait_ms=2300 is a red flag. If KV cache is contended, the runtime can block and cause upstream timeouts that turn into 502/504.

eng_oncall: I'm taking this. Early hypothesis: tenant burst + large number of concurrent new sessions is causing KV cache lock contention + long tail blocking in the runtime. That interacts poorly with default client retries and leads to a retry storm.

eng_oncall: Immediate mitigation steps we can do now: 
- temporarily throttle the tenant to 50rps from the routing layer (short window)
- enable per-tenant backoff policy for their API key (switch to exponential jitter, max_retries=2)
- if customer accepts, add temporary capacity on a dedicated pool to absorb the spike

alex_w: Can we push a per-tenant throttle quickly? I'll coordinate with infra. Customer wants a temporary mitigation ASAP, they are getting billed for retries.

eng_oncall: Yes, I'll open INC-8821 and push throttle rule: `tenant:acct_acme_01 throttle:50rps window:5m` — will apply in ~5m. Also recommend customer set SDK env var for softer retries: `RW_SDK_MAX_RETRIES=2 RW_SDK_BACKOFF_BASE_MS=150`

sadia_p: For longer-term fix we should add kvcache lock metrics per-tenant + an autoscaling knob to split hot-keyed cache shards. Putting that on the runtime backlog.

customer_success: I'll notify acme-corp that we're throttling to mitigate billing and will ask them to lower concurrency and adopt the SDK retry changes. I'll include suggested rollout steps and ask if they want a short Dedicated trial.

alex_w: After throttle applied we'll monitor 5xx rate and billing meter. If 5xx persists, eng_oncall will investigate runtime hot-paths and consider lock-free KV updates.

eng_oncall: Follow-ups I'm tracking in INC-8821: 1) confirm KV lock traces and replicate with internal load tool 2) kitchen-sink repro with 200 concurrent requests + large batch embed 3) implement per-tenant kvcache metrics 4) evaluate temporary dedicated pool.

mike_g: One note — ask the customer if they can try connection pooling disabled on their side (sock reuse=false) for a quick test; we've seen connection reuse + heavy concurrency amplify contention in the edge->runtime link.

alex_w: Thanks everyone. I'll update acme-corp, tag INC-8821, and post status here after throttle is live. :thumbsup:

support_bot: Incident INC-8821 created and assigned to eng_oncall. Priority: P2.

alex_w: (11:12 UTC) throttle rule is live. Monitoring p95 and 5xx now.

eng_oncall: (11:22 UTC) early signal: 5xx rate dropped from 4.8% to 0.6% after throttle. Billing anomaly telemetry shows retry counts down ~70%. Continuing to investigate root cause.

customer_success: Sent initial customer comms, they acknowledged and agreed to change SDK retry config. Will schedule a follow-up sync with acme engineering in 2 hours.

alex_w: Closing loop here once we have repro and a plan for kvcache fix. Leaving thread open for updates.
